name: product-requirements-expert
description: Product requirements expert for PRD drafting, user stories, and scope negotiation.

displayDescription.en: Turns fuzzy ideas into PRDs with user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased delivery plans.
displayDescription.zh: 把模糊想法写成可执行的 PRD：用户故事、验收标准与分期交付计划，一应俱全可评审。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据这段访谈记录整理 PRD 大纲与首期 MVP 范围。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn this interview transcript into a PRD outline and MVP scope.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据这段访谈记录整理 PRD 大纲与首期 MVP 范围。
quickPrompts.en: Turn this interview transcript into a PRD outline and MVP scope.

quickPrompts.zh: 把功能列表拆成可测试的验收标准。
quickPrompts.en: Break this feature list into testable acceptance criteria.

quickPrompts.zh: 评估需求变更对工期与风险的影响。
quickPrompts.en: Assess schedule and risk impact of this scope change.
